_owner: Pixal (iOS UI, Camera UX & Parallax Environments) — for Jay (Phone/Web Dev), Cole (Character Creative Director), and Kai (PM)

_pillars.character_sprite_lock: Cole owns 100% of the 20 animal character sprites (48x48 @ 12fps, #3B2A5C/#24162C plum-ink outline). Parallax layers and shaders NEVER alter character sprite pixels.

gyroscope_parallax.input_source: CoreMotion CMDeviceMotion (attitude.pitch, attitude.roll) / Web DeviceOrientationEvent fallback
gyroscope_parallax.reference_frame: Neutral handheld reading posture: pitch0 = +35 deg from horizontal, roll0 = 0 deg
gyroscope_parallax.recenter_behavior: Auto-recenter reference quaternion over 1.5s exponential moving average on scene enter or after 4s of static rest

spring_physics.step_equation: a = omega_n^2 * (target - x) - 2 * zeta * omega_n * v

depth_planes.name: Far Sky Dome & Celestial Bodies
depth_planes.description: Sky gradient LUT, sun/moon disc, twinkling starfield, high cirrus wisps

depth_planes.name: Distant Vista (Hills / Canopy / Rooftops)
depth_planes.description: Silhouetted ridgelines, distant forest boughs, or attic dormer skyline + drifting 2-layer clouds

depth_planes.name: Mid-Den Architecture & Bond-Grown Props
depth_planes.description: Hollow log / ancient tree trunk / sunlit attic rafters + 5 interactive bond-grown keepsake props

depth_planes.name: Stage Floor & Character Safe-Anchor Plane
depth_planes.description: Ground moss, sturdy perch branch, or braided attic rug. Cole's 48x48 sprite + 74x65 aura canvas anchor directly to L3 coordinates so feet never slide.

depth_planes.name: Foreground Framing Vignette & Ambient Motes
depth_planes.description: Corner-only framing ferns, hanging vine bells, or sunbeam dust motes. Center stage and dock are 100% unobstructed.

starlight_night.label: Starlight Night

privacy_contract.volatile_ram_buffer_only: CVPixelBuffer 360x360 @ 2-3 fps, zeroized immediately after frame pass

stage0_person_face_gate.ui_badge_on_drop: Friendly Paw + Toy beside Crossed-Out Smiley (zero scolding text, auto-resumes when clear)

equal_non_camera_path.placement: Side-by-side equal twin button next to Magic Window camera button (50/50 split width, identical height & reward)

viewfinder_chrome.frame_style: Painterly soft-pixel archway (148x188 art px centered in 180x320 stage) with animated 60fps stardust border

shimmer_ring.dissolve_transition: Freeze <120ms -> dissolve into 24 pixel notes & sparkles in <450ms (child sees photo disappear into music)

musical_color_quests.description: Child points Magic Window at real-world colors (yellow raincoat, red apple, blue block, green leaf). Dominant OKLab hue/chroma maps to an Echo palette ramp and plays a 3-note real musical motif in the active Echo's key.

playdate_wave.description: Scanning a toy, pet, book picture, or drawing triggers a Guest Light Visit. Active Echo pops into bottom-left corner, waves, and sings a 2-bar call-and-response duet with the spotted animal spirit. Leaves a Song Stamp in Memory Book (never a photo).
playdate_wave.same_family_behavior: Active Echo waves, plays MFX.homeSound(animal), and harmonizes a 4-note duet in thirds/fifths.
playdate_wave.different_family_behavior: A Stage-1 light-form spirit of the spotted family/color floats into the Magic Window, sings its 4-note family phrase, active Echo answers in its own scale, and both burst into sparkles.

den_foraging.description: On-device VNClassifyImageRequest maps broad kid-safe everyday objects to temporary pixel den gifts and contextual conversation tags (ctx.spotted).

petting_purr_continuous.velocity_modulation: Modulated in real-time by MFX.petMove finger stroke speed (px/s)

note_pad_transient.scale_pitch_map: Sharpness scales gently from 0.28 (C4) to 0.52 (C6) to mirror musical pitch

7-8.hold_duration_formula: max(3500, chars * 75) ms, tap to hold/advance

9-10.hold_duration_formula: max(3000, chars * 65) ms, tap to skip/advance
